category_title: Students with EBD experiencing behavioral outbursts and academic difficulties in science
scenario_title: Hands-on inquiry science and listening to directions
minimal_context: Sam is participating in a hands-on inquiry science lesson where students must formulate their own questions and design experiments.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, for this hands-on inquiry science lesson, we are going to spend our time formulating our own questions and designing our own experiments.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I cannot wait to get started!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Before you begin, listen closely to the directions for how to set up a complex scientific question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away from the teacher) I don't even know anything about this unit yet. Hey, what are you going to do?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Sam, please pay attention to the instructions so you know how to do the task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Talking to a peer instead of listening to directions) This is too hard. I'm not doing this, let's just mess around with the stuff on the table.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, for this hands-on inquiry science lesson, we are going to spend our time formulating our own questions and designing our own experiments.

STUDENT: I cannot wait to get started!

TUTOR: Before you begin, listen closely to the directions for how to set up a complex scientific question.

STUDENT: (Turns away from the teacher) I don't even know anything about this unit yet. Hey, what are you going to do?

TUTOR: Sam, please pay attention to the instructions so you know how to do the task.

STUDENT: (Talking to a peer instead of listening to directions) This is too hard. I'm not doing this, let's just mess around with the stuff on the table.

task.content: Listening to directions during hands-on inquiry science instruction and formulating their own questions and designing their own experiments

context.environment: Hands-on, inquiry-based format that tends to be less structured
context.materials: Academic task checklist, self-monitoring tools, points/rewards system
context.social_setting: Working in groups or peer learning

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When faced with complex and challenging academic tasks
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Off-task behavior (e.g., talking to a peer instead of listening to directions)
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Begins science units with less background knowledge than their peers
related_quotes: Sam cannot wait to get started!

behavior_patterns.condition: During hands-on inquiry science instruction as these lessons tend to be less structured
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Talking to a peer instead of listening to directions
